note: Commercially he is a strong fit: 48, built a book of business that pays him without requiring work, owns more than one property, travels for months at a time, and has already spent $1,400 a month on a trainer. At 205 lb and 5'10" walking 12-25k steps a day he is not deconditioned, and health is plainly the neglected corner of an otherwise good life. He misses good-to-great because his own framing is rescue, not optimisation — 'so many years of apathy and weakness' and 'I'm amazing at self-loathing'. The more important point is one the stated ICP cannot express: the criterion that should have governed this call is whether an unrepaired labrum tear under active physical therapy can perform the programme's core movement library, and there is no clinical criterion in the ICP at all. This is the same failure already recorded against the Tyron Giuliani call — except that one was lost on clinical grounds and this one closed at full price.
